Executive Assistant at Cube. London. Apply for this Executive Assistant opportunity through the original employer or job source.

Job Description

CUBE are a global RegTech business defining and implementing the gold standard of regulatory intelligence for the financial services industry. We deliver our services through intuitive SaaS solutions, powered by AI, to simplify the complex and everchanging world of compliance for our clients. Why us? 🌍 CUBE is a globally recognized brand at the forefront of Regulatory Technology. Our industry-leading SaaS solutions are trusted by the world’s top financial institutions globally. 🚀 In 2024, we achieved over 50% growth, both organically and through two strategic acquisitions. We’re a fast-paced, high-performing team that thrives on pushing boundaries—continuously evolving our products, services, and operations. At CUBE, we don’t just keep up we stay ahead. 🌱 We believe our future is built by bold, ambitious individuals who are driven to make a real difference. Our “make it happen” culture empowers you to take ownership of your career and accelerate your personal and professional development from day one. 🌐 With over 700 CUBERs across 19 countries spanning EMEA, the Americas, and APAC, we operate as one team with a shared mission to transform regulatory compliance. Diversity, collaboration, and purpose are the heartbeat of our success. 💡 We were among the first to harness the power of AI in regulatory intelligence, and we continue to lead with our cutting-edge technology. At CUBE, You will work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI research and engineering in developing impactful solutions that are reshaping the world of regulatory compliance. Purpose: This is a dual-focus role combining executive support with responsibility for our London front of house. As an Executive Assistant to our C-Suite, you will act as a trusted partner to our senior leaders — managing their time, communications and priorities with precision and discretion. Alongside this, you will ensure our London office presents a consistently professional, welcoming experience for visitors, clients and employees alike. This is a role for someone who is equally comfortable preparing a board briefing pack and greeting a visiting client at reception. You will be proactive, highly organised and confident managing competing demands across both workstreams. Responsibilities: Executive Assistant Support Manage complex and dynamic diaries for C-Suite executives, prioritising effectively across competing demands and shifting schedules. Act as a reliable gatekeeper — filtering and triaging communications, and ensuring the right things reach the right people at the right time. Coordinate meetings, appointments and engagements end-to-end, including preparation of agendas, briefing materials and follow-up action tracking. Draft, review and send executive correspondence, presentations and documentation to a high standard. Manage domestic and international travel — including flights, accommodation, ground transport, visas and detailed itineraries. Prepare comprehensive travel packs and proactively manage disruptions, ensuring minimal impact to executive commitments. Support confidential business initiatives and ad hoc projects with discretion and sound judgement. Coordinate expense management and approvals in line with company policy. Assist with the coordination of leadership team meetings, including logistics, papers and action tracking. Front of House & Office Operations Serve as the first point of contact for visitors, clients and guests — delivering a warm, professional and polished front-of-house experience. Manage the reception desk, including answering and directing calls, handling deliveries, and maintaining visitor logs. Oversee meeting room bookings and ensure rooms are set up and ready in advance of meetings. Maintain office supplies, equipment and vendor relationships, ensuring the office is well-stocked and operational at all times. Support the onboarding of new joiners, including desk setup coordination and office orientation. Assist in facilitating internal events as directed by the Events and Communications lead. Ensure front-of-house and communal areas are consistently presentable and reflect our standards. Uphold confidentiality and data protection standards across all visitor and administrative processes. Requirements: 3–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant supporting C-Suite or senior leadership within a fast-paced, professional environment. Proven ability to manage complex executive diaries and competing priorities with a calm, solutions-focused approach. Experience coordinating domestic and international travel, including multi-leg itineraries. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to draft high-quality executive documentation. Strong organisational skills and meticulous attention to detail. A confident, polished front-of-house presence — comfortable as the face of the business for senior visitors and clients. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and modern collaboration platforms. High degree of discretion, professionalism and sound judgement when handling confidential matters. A proactive mindset — anticipating needs before they arise and taking ownership without being asked. Experience supporting executives within a high-growth, technology or private equity-backed business (Advantageous). Interested? If you are passionate about leveraging technology to transform regulatory compliance and meet the qualifications outlined above, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume detailing your relevant experience and interest in CUBE.​ CUBE is an equal opportunity employer.
